item.title: Show HN: Kimi K3 inference on about 100k PS3 nodes
item.summary: I forked RAM coffers and implemented Kimi K3 on PS3, using one-layer-expert-per-node inference. Idea mine, used AI assistance to implement it. Inspired by AirLLM PR 116 ( https://github.com/lyogavin/airllm/pull/316 ). Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49211662 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
